title: ThirdBrain-Paper: Empirical Research Artifacts, Benchmarks, and Failure Taxonomies for AI-Maintained Operational Knowledge Systems
description: Empirical research artifacts, datasets, codebooks, and evaluation benchmarks examining human-AI collaborative workflows in enterprise operational settings. Includes benchmarks for concurrency/retrieval in local AI-indexable knowledge archives (Paper 1) and a 4-month longitudinal failure log dataset across 22 model transitions with dual-coder categorization (Paper 2).
